{{Top|leg}}
A '''swamp midge''' was a creature which was known for darting around herds of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]]. When the human [[Tash Arranda]] crashed her [[Starfly]] vessel into a cluster of asteroids in orbit about [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], her starfly was described as buzzing around the asteroids like a swamp midge darting around a herf of nerfs.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Spore">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Spore]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The creature was mentioned in ''[[Galaxy of Fear: Spore]]''.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Spore"/>
